opening.argument: The video frames FTX through critical context and a casual conference interaction, not a concrete investment pitch. Its title says “Tom Brady pumped FTX the hardest,” while an overlaid post shows Brady before an FTX backdrop alongside a headline about a Texas regulator investigating celebrity FTX endorsements. The speaker merely says, “I'm here with my boy Sam from FTX. We're at KryptoBahamas conference, we're going to start the day. We're do some tik toks for you guys,” describing a planned content activity rather than directing viewers to invest or transfer funds. The visible clips and chart montage do not establish a specific deceptive investment claim, an instruction to act, or any consequential flow of money or data. The material therefore functions as anti-scam commentary and investigation context, not a demonstrated solicitation.
